recipes.name: Country Pork Meatballs with Onion Gravy over Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 500 g/ 1 lb pork mince (ground pork), or any other meat
1 cup panko breadcrumbs, or regular breadcrumbs
2 green onion stems, finely sliced (or 1/2 onion, grated using box grater)
1 garlic clove, finely grated or crushed using a garlic press
1 tsp ground sage (don't skip this! Key flavour)
1 tsp onion powder (substitute garlic powder, or 1 garlic clove finely grated)
1/2 tsp paprika, regular/sweet (or smoked, not spicy)
30g / 2 tbsp unsalted butter, or olive oil
2 small onions, halved then cut into 8mm / 1/3" wedges (or 1 1/2 large onions)
1/4 – 1/2 tsp dark soy sauce or gravy browner – for colour, it won't tasty Asiany! (Note 2)
Mashed potato, pasta, rice or cauliflower rice (low carb)
recipes.method: skillet (large non-stick pan, brown then simmer in gravy)
recipes.notes: Ingredient list runs meatballs, then onion gravy, then serving items; source section headers were not preserved in the fetch.

recipes.name: Oven Baked Country-Style Pork Chops with Potatoes
ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil (or vegetable or canola oil)
4 pork chops / cutlets, around 200-250g/7-8oz each including bone
800g/ 1.6 lb baby potatoes, larger ones cut in half
recipes.method: oven bake (sheet pan, finished under broiler)

recipes.name: Slow Cooker BBQ Country Style Pork Ribs over Rice
ingredients: ½ cup finely diced white onion
recipes.notes: Source recipe is ribs only; rice is not part of the source ingredient list.

recipes.name: Creamy Pork Stew with Potatoes and Carrots
ingredients: ¾ teaspoon EACH: dried oregano, ground sage
½ teaspoon EACH: pepper, celery salt
2 ½ lbs. pork butt, (Boston butt), see notes
¾ cup dry white wine, see notes
1 lb. baby red potatoes, I leave the skins on.
recipes.method: dutch oven braise (stovetop; slow cooker variation given)

recipes.name: Colombian Pork Loin with Blackberry Sauce

recipes.notes: No nutrition data published. "4 garlic loves minced" is a typo in the source, transcribed verbatim.

recipes.name: Haluski and Kielbasa (Cabbage and Egg Noodles)
ingredients: ½ cup Butter for frying 1 stick
1 pound kielbasa cut into thin slices
1 Head of cabbage washed and roughly chopped

recipes.name: Kielbasa Cabbage and Potato Skillet
ingredients: 1 pound potatoes any variety, peeled and chopped into 1/-inch pieces
1/2 – 1 teaspoon kosher salt adjust to taste
1 tablespoon refined coconut oil or light olive oil plus more only if needed
1/2 medium head green cabbage sliced into ribbons, about 4 cups worth
recipes.notes: Source states "4-5 servings"; midpoint rounded to 5. Published nutrition appears calculated on 4 servings.

recipes.name: Bigos (Polish Hunter's Stew)
ingredients: 4 chicken thighs or other meats, see Notes
14.11 ounces (400 g) Polish smoked sausage kielbasa, diced
0.25 ounces (7 g) dried porcini mushrooms small handful
1⅓ teaspoons caraway seeds, dried marjoram and paprika each
recipes.notes: Source uses chicken thighs alongside the kielbasa; note says other meats may be substituted.

recipes.name: Szegedin Goulash (Pork and Sauerkraut Paprika Stew)
ingredients: 1 green bell pepper, seeded and finely chopped
1½ pounds pork (e.g. shoulder) and beef (chuck roast), trimmed of fat and cut into ½ inch pieces (1 1/2 pounds total, not each)
4 tablespoons quality imported sweet Hungarian paprika (yes, that's TABLEspoons!)
¼ teaspoon freshly ground black pepper
½ teaspoon caraway seeds, coarsely crushed
water or beef broth (beef broth isn't traditional but it creates even more flavor)
1 cup packed drained real German sauerkraut
recipes.method: dutch oven braise (dutch oven or stock pot, simmer)

recipes.name: Hungarian Pork and Potato Goulash (Porkolt)
ingredients: 1 lb onions 500 g, about 5 medium onions
7 oz carrots 200 g, about 3 medium carrots
½ teaspoon hot paprika powder but not smoked
fine sea salt and freshly ground black pepper

recipes.name: Fasolka po Bretonsku (Polish Baked Beans with Kielbasa)
ingredients: 14 oz (0.9 lb; 400 g) dry large butter/lima beans; can be replaced with 2 cans (16 oz; 400-450 g each); more details in the post above
1 medium onion (4 oz; 120 g), white or yellow
1 tablespoon lard, can be replaced with neutral cooking oil
0.5 cup (120-125 ml) dry red wine; can be replaced with stock or skipped completely
14 oz (400 g) canned diced tomatoes in tomato juice
1 teaspoon dried savory; can be replaced with dried thyme or 1 sprig of fresh savory/thyme
1 tablespoon fresh parsley, chopped; for garnish
recipes.method: soup pot (simmer on medium-low after frying in a skillet)

recipes.name: Polish Leczo (Kielbasa and Peppers Stew)

1 lb (450 g) kiełbasa sausage (in Poland, try 'wiejska' or 'śląska')
2 tbsp lard, can sub with canola or olive oil
½ tsp spicy paprika powder, or chili powder
2 lb (900 g) tomatoes, can sub with 17.6 oz (500ml) tomato purée passata
recipes.method: skillet (deep skillet or wide pot with lid, fry then simmer)

recipes.name: Senfbraten (German Mustard-Gravy Pork Roast)

recipes.notes: German mustard and oil are listed without quantities in the source.

recipes.name: Bratwurst and Sauerkraut with Potatoes

5 bratwurst links (about 16-20 ounces total), cut into 2-inch pieces
½ cup German beer (or substitute apple cider, chicken broth, or beef broth)

recipes.name: Creamy Kielbasa and Potato Soup

6 large bratwursts pricked several times with a fork
¾ cup low sodium chicken stock OR white wine

recipes.name: Sausage, Cabbage and Apple Skillet

Eggs – as many as you want! (and can fit)
